review_notes: I reviewed the whole file, lines 1–42. It has a long preamble of `attribute [-instance]` and `attribute [-simp]` lines, then one theorem. The only repeated reasoning is the two symmetric `calc` blocks in the `le_antisymm` proof. Each block turns an injection `V →ₗ Dual W` into `finrank V ≤ finrank (Dual W)` with `LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective`. Each then rewrites with `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq`. Each block is two steps, so this is short calculation and a thin wrapper around existing API. A shared lemma would be about as long as the two uses together, and the proof has only two uses. It would not clearly make the file easier to read or maintain, so I did not report a finding. I did not open the imported theorems or Mathlib to look for a more compact existing lemma.
